adoption_scope: Guidance and implementation defaults; not media, motion, science, platform or publication approval.

design.direction: 结构可信、光影细腻、材质通透的精细纯2D绘画式自然插画；整景、主体和机制同一完成度
design.design_board_scope: record the actual current board version/hash and reviewed scope; the bundled reference selects appearance only

audio.speaker: Serena
audio.instruct: 自然口语，像认真向朋友连续解释一个有趣现象。用平实、连贯的语气讲清因果，重音和停顿跟随当前语义。不要朗诵腔，不要逐字停顿，普通话清晰。
audio.runtime_parameters: Use the confirmed project's verified runtime; local adapter examples apply only when that adapter is explicitly selected.

captions.scale_policy: Same aspect ratio: multiply vertical values by output_height/1920, record rounding; different layout requires review.
captions.exclude: Published or already-approved-for-publication versions are not changed by this setting.
captions.move_scope: Captions and tight background only; document any necessary local label reflow.
captions.scope: legacy_portrait_revision_only; not the default for new landscape work

delivery.default_scope: Future new productions and explicitly requested landscape work only; preserve approved/published portrait identities and media.

permissions: Follow the current task, version approvals, pauses and cancellations; config adoption grants none.

platform_sync.scope: current series only; no new platform authority

daily_counting.unpublished_inventory: not_automatically_eligible; determine new-work scope from source/version evidence

landscape_captions.policy: Design against actual scene and platform, then inspect exported text and tight backgrounds. Never scale legacy portrait Y coordinates into this layout.
